settingsFootnote: How GOTCHA behaves lives in <studio>Studio</studio>, not here.

settingsDescription.workspace: The facts your AI employees quote to customers. Change one here and every channel is consistent within a minute.
settingsDescription.people: Humans and AI employees in one list, because operationally they are the same resource.
settingsDescription.channels: Where customers reach you. Everything lands in one inbox.
settingsDescription.systems: What GOTCHA can see and change on your behalf. Connecting a system gives your AI employees new things they can do — you decide which.
settingsDescription.notifications: GOTCHA never pings you for an incoming message — that's what the inbox is for. It tells you when something needs a decision or something broke.
settingsDescription.security: Who can get in, and a record of everything that happened — by a person or by GOTCHA.
settingsDescription.billing: Your plan, what the month has used, and what it bought you.
settingsDescription.developer: For whoever builds against GOTCHA. Nothing here affects how GOTCHA behaves.
